g.text: 2023 El Niño: RO, RO + PMM and NCEP CFSv2

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9b4335

g.text: Three-month means at their central month; February–June issues / monthly-state initializations.
Skill: the same 25 issue–season pairs across all six methods, center leads 1–5. Longer curves are displayed but not scored.
RO / observations: ERSSTv5 SSTA (1991–2020), with trend restored. IRI retains provider baselines; information dates differ.
IRI open circles are prior observed-season references, not model initial states. Dashed links are guides and are not scored.
Standard PMM-SST; frozen manuscript model. IRI values extracted from official vector plumes (CC BY 4.0).
